title: 2021 HMMT November Theme Problem 1
statement: Let \(n\) be the answer to this problem. In acute triangle \(A B C\), point \(D\) is located on side \(B C\) so that \(\angle B A D=\angle D A C\) and point \(E\) is located on \(A C\) so that \(B E \perp A C\). Segments \(B E\) and \(A D\) intersect at \(X\) such that \(\angle B X D=n^{\circ}\). Given that \(\angle X B A=16^{\circ}\), find the measure of \(\angle B C A\).

solutions.text:
Since \(B E \perp A C, \angle B A E=90^{\circ}-\angle A B E=74^{\circ}\). Now, \(n^{\circ}=180-\angle B X A=\angle E B A+\angle B A D=\) \(16^{\circ}+\frac{74^{\circ}}{2}=53^{\circ}\).
